title: Add MiniMax-backed harness parity to Go AO
description:
Go AO production daemon is healthy, but its registered harnesses do not include the TypeScript AO minimax plugin. Track https://github.com/jleechanorg/agent-orchestrator/issues/19.

Context:
- Upstream ask filed 2026-07-11: https://github.com/AgentWrapper/agent-orchestrator/issues/2614 (OPEN) - "Add app-wide provider credentials/settings for Claude-compatible providers like MiniMax." Checked adjacent-but-insufficient issues first: https://github.com/AgentWrapper/agent-orchestrator/issues/2195 (OPEN, per-role env profile, broader scope) and https://github.com/AgentWrapper/agent-orchestrator/issues/135 (CLOSED, old openrouter/minimax ask).
- Worktree: /Users/jleechan/projects/agent-orchestrator-minimax-user-scope, branch minimax-user-scope, based on upstream/main tip 3d520de8895b240f05a284a9523dd83947c9e3f6 (verified via git log upstream/main -1 returning the identical SHA on 2026-07-11).
- Working tree has UNCOMMITTED changes: new file backend/internal/providersettings/providersettings.go; modified backend/internal/session_manager/manager.go. Not yet committed, built, installed, or validated - the live ~/bin/ao-go binary (mtime 2026-07-06) does not contain this code.
- Open design question (flag, do not silently resolve): issue #19 original acceptance criteria say "without storing API secrets in repository/config state" / "no secrets persisted." The implementation stores minimaxApiKey in plaintext JSON at ~/.ao/data/provider-settings.json (app-wide user-scope file, NOT per-project/repo config - same class of pattern as gh CLI's ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml). This satisfies "not in repository/config state" but is a literal violation of "no secrets persisted" if read strictly. Needs an explicit accept/reject decision before this bead is closed.
- Staleness note: signatures/paths verified 2026-07-11 against worktree HEAD 3d520de8895b240f05a284a9523dd83947c9e3f6 (working tree, uncommitted). Re-verify before continuing if picked up later - the worktree is mutable.

Implementation (drafted, uncommitted - see follow-up bead for build/install/validate):
- Files: backend/internal/providersettings/providersettings.go (new); backend/internal/session_manager/manager.go (modified: Spawn, relaunchRestoredSession, spawnEnv, runtimeEnv, +providerEnv).
- Current API signatures (copied from live worktree code, 2026-07-11):
  type State struct { MinimaxAPIKey string "json:\"minimaxApiKey,omitempty\"" }
  func Path(dataDir string) string                          // dataDir/provider-settings.json; default dataDir = ~/.ao/data (config.go:115)
  func Load(path string) (State, error)                     // missing file is not an error, returns zero State
  func ClaudeEnvForModel(model string, state State) map[string]string  // fires only when strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(model), "minimax-") and key != ""
- Call-site (manager.go):
  func (m *Manager) providerEnv(model string) map[string]string {
      state, err := providersettings.Load(providersettings.Path(m.dataDir))
      // warn+nil on error
      return providersettings.ClaudeEnvForModel(model, state)
  }
  runtimeEnv(...) gained a model string param and now calls spawnEnv(id, project, issue, m.dataDir, m.providerEnv(model), projectEnv) - spawnEnv applies baseEnv (provider settings) FIRST, then projectEnv OVERWRITES matching keys (project override still wins), then AO-internal vars are added last (unchanged, still win over both).
- Constraints: preserve the baseEnv -> projectEnv -> AO-internal layering order; do not reorder.
- Non-goals (this pass): no desktop UI/editor for the setting yet (frontend/src/renderer/components/GlobalSettingsForm.tsx and frontend/src/main/update-settings.ts unchanged, confirmed via grep - zero hits for providersettings/minimaxApiKey in frontend/).
- Forbidden path: do not duplicate the MiniMax key into per-project config.env as a workaround - that is exactly the anti-pattern issue #2614 exists to remove.

Acceptance criteria:
- Standards: baseEnv -> projectEnv -> AO-internal env layering order preserved; secret lives only in the app-wide user-scope file, never in repo/project config.
- Static checks: cd /Users/jleechan/projects/agent-orchestrator-minimax-user-scope/backend && go build ./... succeeds.
- Tests: add unit coverage for providersettings.ClaudeEnvForModel (prefix match incl. case-insensitivity, empty-key no-op) and providersettings.Load (missing-file zero-value, malformed-JSON error) - none exist yet.
- Evidence: a real worker spawn with a minimax-* model shows ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.minimax.io/anthropic in the spawned process env, captured via a real session smoke (not unit-test-only, per evidence-standards for daemon/runtime behavior).
- Done when: the open design question above is explicitly accepted or the storage approach changed, AND either this bead scope is fully delivered or split into the build/install/validate follow-up bead.

title: ao spawn needs --model flag to make global provider-settings usable
description:
Context:
- Source: sidekick mission minimax-fork-pr-and-cleanup, lane E (worldarchitect migration), 2026-07-12. Evidence: /tmp/agent-orchestrator/sidekick/minimax-fork-pr-and-cleanup/evidence/E-worldarchitect-migration.md
- Current head: canonical jleechanorg/agent-orchestrator @ 879c4355 (after providersettings + spawnEnv test fix)
- Repro: on Linux (jeff-ubuntu) or Mac, /home/jleechan/.local/bin/ao-go spawn --help — there is no --model flag. The only harness override is --harness, but that does not propagate a model name into the spawned claude-code session.
- Finding: After migrating worldarchitect.ai off its legacy per-project agentConfig.model=MiniMax-M3, the only way to spawn a MiniMax worker is to put agentConfig.model back into per-project config — exactly the anti-pattern the migration was trying to escape. Workers default to Claude Max (the user's own subscription) and providersettings.ClaudeEnvForModel returns nil because no model trigger starts with minimax-.

Why it matters:
- The whole point of providersettings.go was to remove per-project secret duplication and let the global ~/.ao/data/provider-settings.json be the single source of MiniMax credentials. But without a per-spawn model flag, there is no way to actually USE the credentials unless every project permanently carries the model name in its config. This is a one-line capability gap blocking the migration goal.

Implementation:
- File: backend/internal/cli/spawn.go (or wherever spawn flags are registered)
- Add a --model string flag analogous to --harness, store it on SpawnConfig, propagate to effectiveAgentConfig().Model for the spawned worker's agentConfig (same path the project-config model uses today).
- Current API signatures copied from live code (canonical @ 879c4355):
  type SpawnConfig struct {
      Name      string
      ProjectID ProjectID
      IssueID   IssueID
      Harness   Harness
      Prompt    string
      ClaimPR   string
      ...
  }
- Call-site shape: a flagged --model MiniMax-M3 on ao spawn should produce a session whose claude-code worker is invoked with model=MiniMax-M3 in its agentConfig — which then triggers providersettings.ClaudeEnvForModel to inject the env vars.
- Constraints: do not change the default for projects that don't pass --model (they keep their existing project-config model or the harness default). Do not introduce a global default model that would change behavior for existing projects.
- Non-goals: no support for per-spawn provider credentials beyond what providersettings.go already accepts. No support for per-spawn baseUrl overrides (use the global file).
- Forbidden paths: do not put MiniMax key into per-project config.env as a workaround (that is exactly the anti-pattern issue #2614 was filed to remove). Do not invent a new config layer when --model on spawn suffices.

Acceptance criteria:
- Standards: ao spawn --model <name> documented and accepted; CLI help text reflects it.
- Static checks: go build ./... clean, go vet ./... clean.
- Tests: existing spawn tests still pass; add one test that --model propagates into the spawned worker's effectiveAgentConfig.
- Evidence: a real spawn with --model MiniMax-M3 produces a session whose tmux pane banner shows MiniMax-M3 (not Claude Max), and a parallel spawn with --model sonnet produces a session with Sonnet 5 banner. Capture pane text for both.
- Done when: worldarchitect.ai (or any project) can spawn a MiniMax worker via ao spawn --model MiniMax-M3 without any per-project config.

Staleness note: signatures and SpawnConfig verified at canonical @ 879c4355, 2026-07-12. Re-read before implementation — spawn.go may move.

title: ao-go project set-config --model REPLACES entire config (destructive footgun)
description:
Context:
- Source: sidekick mission minimax-fork-pr-and-cleanup, lane E, 2026-07-12. Evidence: /tmp/agent-orchestrator/sidekick/minimax-fork-pr-and-cleanup/evidence/E-worldarchitect-migration.md §5c.
- Current head: canonical @ 879c4355
- Repro on Linux: /home/jleechan/.local/bin/ao-go project set-config worldarchitect.ai --model sonnet --json
- Finding: ao-go project set-config's single-field flags (--model, --permission, --orchestrator-agent, --worker-agent, etc.) REPLACE the entire project config rather than MERGE with the existing values. After --model sonnet on worldarchitect.ai, the resulting config lost defaultBranch, sessionPrefix, permissions, worker.agent, orchestrator, and trackerIntake.

Why it matters:
- This is a destructive footgun: anyone using the new global provider-settings approach and then trying to tweak a single project field via --model/--permission will silently lose sessionPrefix (turning wa-N session IDs into nameless ones), defaultBranch (breaking worktree creation), permissions (forcing the default permission prompt mode), and worker.agent (reverting to claude-code default or whatever fallback). The migration today had to be rescued with an explicit --config-json re-application when the negative smoke test ran --model sonnet.

Implementation:
- File: backend/internal/cli/project.go (set-config command)
- Either:
  (a) Change single-field flags to MERGE into existing config instead of REPLACE, OR
  (b) Add a --merge flag (default off for backward compat) that switches behavior, OR
  (c) Make --model/--permission/--orchestrator-agent/--worker-agent explicitly safe-by-merge while keeping --config-json as the destructive explicit option.
- Recommendation: (c) is the safest backward-compatible change — single-field flags preserve other fields, --config-json remains explicit destructive. This matches user intuition that "set the model field" should only touch the model field.
- Current API signatures (from project.go set-config):
  func setConfigCmd() *cobra.Command
  // flags: --config-json, --clear, --default-branch, --env, --model, --orchestrator-agent, --permission, --post-create, --session-prefix, --symlink, --tracker-assignee, --tracker-intake, --tracker-repo, --worker-agent
- Call-site shape: ao-go project set-config worldarchitect.ai --model sonnet should produce a config that has model:sonnet AND retains sessionPrefix:wa, defaultBranch:main, permissions:bypass-permissions, worker.agent:claude-code, etc.

Constraints:
- --config-json must remain destructive (it's the explicit "wipe and replace" path).
- --clear must remain destructive (that's its purpose).
- Single-field flags should merge over existing values, not overwrite.
- Backward compatible: existing users of single-field flags (without --config-json) who relied on destructive behavior will see MORE fields preserved, not fewer — should be safe.

Non-goals: no support for fine-grained merge semantics (e.g. "merge only this subtree"). No removal of --config-json.

Forbidden paths: do not silently ignore single-field flags when they would conflict with --config-json. Do not introduce a --no-merge opt-out.

Acceptance criteria:
- Standards: ao-go project set-config --help documents the merge behavior for single-field flags.
- Static checks: go build ./... clean, go vet ./... clean.
- Tests: existing set-config tests still pass; add one test that --model on a project with full existing config preserves sessionPrefix, defaultBranch, permissions, worker.agent.
- Evidence: ao-go project set-config worldarchitect.ai --model sonnet → ao-go project get worldarchitect.ai shows sessionPrefix=wa, defaultBranch=main, permissions=bypass-permissions all preserved.
- Done when: the negative-smoke-test scenario from lane E (--model sonnet loses other fields) no longer reproduces.

Staleness note: verified at canonical @ 879c4355, 2026-07-12. Re-read project.go before implementation.

title: Add case-insensitivity unit tests for providersettings.ClaudeEnvForModel
description:
Context:
- Source: sidekick mission minimax-fork-pr-and-cleanup, lane D /er verdict, 2026-07-12. Evidence: /tmp/agent-orchestrator/sidekick/minimax-fork-pr-and-cleanup/evidence/D-er-verdict.md §"Does NOT Prove"
- Current head: canonical @ 879c4355 (providersettings.go)
- Finding: The /er verdict PASSes on the evidence bundle, but explicitly notes that the "(case-insensitive)" claim about the minimax- prefix was never actually tested. The Mac smoke only exercised MiniMax-M3 (mixed case, exact-match of the camelCase "MiniMax" prefix via strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(model), "minimax-")) and sonnet. No MINIMAX- (all upper) or minimax- (all lower) variant was tested.

Why it matters:
- The feature is advertised as case-insensitive. The /er verdict's PASS rests on partial coverage. If a user names a model "MINIMAX-EXP" the daemon should still inject env vars — but that's not actually been proven.

Implementation:
- File: backend/internal/providersettings/providersettings.go (already exists at canonical @ 879c4355). No code change needed — strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(model), "minimax-") already lowercases for the prefix check.
- This bead is for **test coverage**, not implementation. Add a unit test in providersettings_test.go (new file, alongside providersettings.go) that covers:
  - "MiniMax-M3" (mixed case, exact-match) — env injected
  - "minimax-M3" (all lowercase) — env injected
  - "MINIMAX-M3" (all uppercase) — env injected
  - "minimax-M3-HighEffort" (suffix) — env injected
  - "sonnet" (no minimax prefix) — no env
  - "M3" (contains but doesn't start with) — no env
  - " minimax-" (leading whitespace) — no env (or env, document the behavior)
  - Empty model — no env
  - Empty key (minimax_api_key="") — no env

Constraints: Use Go's standard testing package. No external deps. Test file must be in the same package (package providersettings) so it can call unexported helpers if needed.

Non-goals: no integration test against a real ao daemon (unit-only is sufficient for prefix-detection logic). No changing the prefix detection behavior.

Forbidden paths: do not add a regex-based test (the implementation uses strings.HasPrefix — test that, not the spec).

Acceptance criteria:
- Standards: providersettings_test.go exists in backend/internal/providersettings/, covers all 8 cases above.
- Static checks: go build ./... clean, go vet ./... clean, go test ./internal/providersettings/... PASS.
- Tests: the new tests must pass and must catch a deliberate regression (e.g. if the implementation is changed to strings.HasPrefix(model, "minimax-") without ToLower, the all-uppercase test should fail).
- Evidence: full go test ./internal/providersettings/... output captured.
- Done when: the test file exists and passes, AND a deliberate regression to case-sensitive matching causes the appropriate test to fail.

Staleness note: providersettings.go verified at canonical @ 879c4355, 2026-07-12. Re-read before adding tests — the implementation may have evolved.
